rules.statement: The possession of a property by a defendant is considered 'undisturbed and uninterrupted possession' if they have been in continuous possession for more than ten years.
rules.supporting_quote: In the presence of the above evidence, it is not difficult to hold that the possession of this property by Defendant is ‘undisturbed and uninterrupted possession’ within the meaning of Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance.
